author: flovoice53-tech
description: MCP server that gives an AI agent a disposable email address and a real UK phone number so it can test a signup/verification flow end to end.
name: agent-identity-mcp

tools.name: create_test_email
tools.title: Create a disposable test email address
tools.description: Get a fresh, real email address that can receive mail for a short time — use it to sign up for something you're testing, then call get_test_email_messages to read what arrives.

ttlMinutes.description: How long the address stays valid, in minutes (max 60).

tools.name: get_test_email_messages
tools.title: Read messages for a test email address
tools.description: Get the messages received so far on an address created with create_test_email.

tools.name: list_services
tools.title: List phone-verification services
tools.description: List the services a real UK phone number can be rented for (WhatsApp, Telegram, Google, Discord, etc.), with prices.

tools.name: rent_test_phone_number
tools.title: Rent a real test phone number
tools.description: Rent a real UK phone number for a given service so it can receive an SMS/OTP verification code. Debits the account balance. Returns a rentalId to check with wait_for_test_sms.

period.description: instant = one-time rental for a single code; monthly = keep the number for a month.

tools.name: wait_for_test_sms
tools.title: Wait for the SMS/OTP code
tools.description: Block until the first SMS/OTP code arrives on a phone rental, or time out.

timeoutMs.description: Max time to wait, in ms.
